1051160532.description: Elevate your everyday style with this Citizen two-tone ladies' watch, a graceful timepiece that blends timeless elegance with modern innovation. Crafted with a delicate 34mm two-tone stainless steel case and bracelet, it perfectly frames a serene light purple analog dial that catches the light with every movement. Gold-tone hands and hour markers enhance the design's subtle elegance, making this watch a perfect accessory for any occasion — from everyday wear to special evenings out. Powered by innovative Eco-Drive technology, this timepiece runs continuously on any light source, saving you the hassle of ever replacing a battery.

1051160533.description: Member's Mark Ultra Paper Bowls are designed to handle a variety of meals with ease. Featuring a generous 20-oz. capacity, these bowls are perfect for serving hearty soups, stews, pastas, salads, and more. Crafted with a grease-resistant and cut-resistant design, along with advanced soak protection, they ensure no leaks, spills, or soggy bottoms, even with the messiest or most liquid-heavy dishes.

1051160534.description: High polished two-toned bypass hinged bangle is crafted in sterling silver and 14 Karat yellow gold. Elegant and sophisticated wrist wear, instantly elevates attire. Light, flexible and shiny, this hinged bangle is an easy accessory for everyday use. This combines two precious metals, sterling silver and 14k yellow gold for a luxurious look and feel. Sturdy in construction, versatile and easy to wear. Choose to wear alone or stack them with other bracelets, create a unique look each time you wear. The bracelet has a lobster clasp closure for security.

1051160535.description:
Big Screen Entertainment Anywhere
Experience entertainment like never before with the Monster Vision 3 portable speaker. Featuring a built-in 15.6" Full HD LCD display and powerful 100W peak audio, this innovative device is perfect for tailgating, camping, backyard gatherings, or beach days. Its rugged, portable design ensures you can take immersive sound and video wherever life takes you.

1051160536.description: Timeless sterling silver omega chain with faceted oval gold charm encased in silver setting. Classic sterling silver 3mm omega adjustable chain 16"" + 2"" extender for total of 18"" length. Bold and stylish, flexible and masterfully crafted to maximize shine and durability. The unique charm combines bold facets in the gold dome bringing to life sparkly flashes of bright gold color. The grillback gives the pendant a smooth and beautiful finished look. Choose to wear the omega chain alone, with the dazzling charm or stack additional charms to create personalize story. The possibilities are endless with this versitile chain necklace. The closure is lobster clasp for security. Easy gift for any occasion.

1051160537.description: Keto Pint Salted Caramel Almond Crunch Ice Cream Bars, Frozen, 3 oz., 12 ct. are desserts that you can enjoy without compromise. As the leading ketogenic ice cream bar, it was created to help people enjoy their favorite desserts, feel their best, and keep them on track with their dietary needs. Made with family farmed dairy, real milk chocolate, and no added sugar, it contains no artificial sweeteners, flavors, colors, is gluten-free, and keto-friendly.

1051160538.description: Solid foldover heart tassel lariat necklace is carefully crafted in 14k yellow gold. Glamourous and bold, this special necklace is a statement piece that adorns the neckline with bright sparkle and flash. Soft to touch, each strand in the tassel is meticulously joined by a ribbed bar creating a lariat effect. Y shaped design embodies feminine beauty and strength, perfect accessory for special occasions. Svelte and sophisticated necklace instantly elevates any outfit. Tassel measures 1.75"" drop length, while the chain length is 18"". Machine made for precision and fluidity ensuring top quality.

1051160539.description: The Shark Glossi™ 2-in-1 Hot Tool and Air Glosser uses heat-controlled ceramic plates and powerful airflow to smooth hair with each pass—without the frizz** or heat damage*. It stretches, smooths, and adds bounce for any hair type. Create a glossy, bouncy blowout that lasts all day on wet or dry hair.

1051160540.description:
Timeless 14K Yellow Gold Sparkle Rope Chain
Elevate your jewelry collection with this exquisite 14K yellow gold sparkle rope chain. Crafted in Turkey from high-quality 14K gold, this 22-inch chain features a dazzling sparkle finish that beautifully catches the light, creating a radiant and eye-catching look from every angle.

1051160541.description: Elevate your jewelry collection with the timeless brilliance of these Round Cut In and Out Diamond Hoop Earrings in 14K Gold. Elegantly crafted in your choice of high-polish 14K white or yellow gold, these classic hoops are a radiant display of fine craftsmanship and luxurious style. Whether you choose the 1.30, 1.93, or 2.80 carat total weight option, each pair is expertly set with meticulously selected round cut diamonds graded I-VS2 for optimal brilliance and clarity.

1051160542.description: Get in the groove with the Asher Record Storage Console! This console features a mid-century modern design with a sleek profile, sliding doors with a slatted look and tapered legs. Constructed with solid wood, this console is available in a beautiful dark brown finish. It can be used as a credenza in a dining room, as a TV stand in a living room, or as a coffee bar in a kitchen.

1051160543.description: This lovely S Collection Diamond Flower Pendant is both elegant and classy, featuring a total of .50 CT T.W of round brilliant-cut white diamonds. The 7 stones that form the flower are pressure and prong set, hand crafted in 14K yellow gold with a fine Milgrain and high polished finish. The pendant is perfectly complemented by a Pin Style chain that is adjustable from 16" to 18" to suit your desired length and is securely fastened with a lobster claw clasp. This necklace is certified by the world renowned International Gemological Institute with a color and clarity of HI, SI, certificate included. Committed to ethical practices, all diamonds are natural and conflict-free, reflecting our dedication to responsible sourcing.IGI certification is a process by which diamonds are evaluated and Certified to verify their authenticity and quality. The International Gemological Institute (IGI) is the world's largest independent diamond certification and appraisal institute.H-I is a color grade for diamonds, considered to be a desirable, near colorless grade that appears white to the unaided eye. SI is a clarity grade of diamonds which means the stone is slightly included with...

1051160544.description: Add a vibrant touch of luxury to your jewelry collection with this exquisite 0.58 Carat Total Weight Cushion Cut Natural Yellow Halo Diamond Pendant in elegant 18K gold. At the heart of this dazzling piece is a rare Natural Yellow cushion cut diamond, weighing approximately 0.25 carats, certified SI2 clarity and known for its radiant hue and exceptional brilliance. Surrounding the center stone is a glistening halo of 30 round brilliant cut yellow and white diamonds (I color, SI2 clarity), each precisely prong-set to maximize sparkle and depth. The total diamond count is 31, expertly chosen and arranged for optimal light reflection and brilliance.

1051160545.description: Elevate your jewelry collection with the breathtaking brilliance of this 11.20 CT. TW Round Cut Diamond Floral Necklace in 18K White Gold. Exquisitely designed to embody grace and sophistication, this IGI-certified masterpiece showcases 240 round-cut diamonds with a total weight of 11.20 carats, each selected for its radiant I color and VS2 clarity. The diamonds are thoughtfully arranged in an elegant floral motif, creating a continuous garden of shimmer that delicately frames the neckline.

1051160546.description: Elevate your jewelry collection with the exquisite Round Cut Fashion Diamond Ring in 18K White Gold, a timeless piece that effortlessly balances sophistication, sparkle, and versatility. Designed to suit a variety of styles and occasions, this ring features nine dazzling round cut diamonds, expertly arranged in a classic prong setting to enhance their brilliance and maximize light return. With total carat weight options of 1.50, 1.97, or 3.0, you can select the perfect level of sparkle to suit your personal preference or occasion.

1051160547.description: Elevate your jewelry collection with the timeless brilliance of this 0.80 Carat Total Weight Oval Shaped Diamond Earrings and Pendant Set in 14K Gold. Designed to dazzle, this matching set brings together classic elegance and modern craftsmanship, making it the perfect choice for both everyday sophistication and special occasions.

1051160548.description: A timeless celebration of elegance and craftsmanship, this 3.80 Carat Total Weight Round Cut Diamond Floral Bracelet in 18K White Gold exudes radiant sophistication. Certified by IGI for quality and authenticity, this stunning piece features 152 meticulously matched round-cut diamonds, totaling 3.80 carats, each selected for their dazzling I color and VS2 clarity. Set in delicate prongs, the diamonds form an exquisite floral motif that wraps gracefully around the wrist, offering a harmonious blend of brilliance and femininity.

1051160549.description: This stunning elongated cushion cut lab-grown diamond ring is a masterpiece of modern elegance. Featuring a dazzling 3.00 ct center stone, its unique design ensures a timeless and sophisticated look that will captivate attention. The elongated cushion cut enhances the brilliance and sparkle, making it a perfect choice for special moments.

1051160551.description: The Hefty Supreme 3-Compartment Foam Dinner Plates (200 ct.) are strong and sturdy disposable plates that holds a three-course meal with ease. These plates are great for everyday use, as well as for meals enjoyed during special occasions.

1051160555.description: Experience the essence of autumn with Glade Automatic Spray Air Freshener Refills in the limited-edition Fall Night Long fragrance. This delightful scent captures the crispness of fall air, aromatic evergreen, and warm sandalwood, creating a cozy atmosphere perfect for the season.

1051160559.description: Add a touch of Halloween charm to your gatherings with the Member's Mark Halloween Ghost & Bat Serving Set. This set includes two themed trays: a white ghost-shaped tray and a black bat-shaped tray, perfect for fall-themed parties and seasonal decor.

1051160560.description: If you're looking for a styling tool that can give you incredible volume and a long-lasting hold, look no further than Kenra Volume Spray 25. This professional-grade hairspray is designed to provide a firm hold without weighing down your hair, allowing you to achieve the perfect style that lasts all day. The secret to the voluminous look achieved with Kenra Volume Spray 25 lies in its super fine mist. This mist evenly coats each strand of hair, providing maximum control and lift. You can say goodbye to flat and lifeless hair with this hairspray as it helps you achieve a head-turning volume that will make a statement.

1051160562.description:
Experience Dolby Atmos™ 3D Spatial Audio
Immerse yourself in the action with Dolby Atmos™ 3D spatial audio. This advanced soundbar delivers exceptional sound quality, bringing incredible detail, dimensions, and voice clarity to all your favorite content. Whether you're watching movies, playing games, or listening to music, the audio experience is truly transformative.

1051160565.description: Velvet Skin Coat makeup primer is designed to instantly minimize the appearance of pores, fine lines, and imperfections, delivering a smooth, matte look that lasts all day. Its clear, transparent formula is suitable for all skin types and tones, ensuring a seamless application every time. This primer helps makeup glide on effortlessly and stay in place throughout the day.

1051160567.description: Serve up your scary Halloween treats with style and make every meal memorable with these Member's Mark Halloween paper plates. Each paper plate is cut-resistant, soakproof, and BPI commercially compostable. The Ghostly Goodies Halloween paper plates are sold in packs of 85, measure a generous 10 inches by 10 inches, and are even microwavable* for reheating your leftovers. Each paper plate is now more sustainable with 6% less wood fiber**, while also delivering the same reliable strength.

1051160568.description:
Unleash Monstrous Gaming Power
The CyberPowerPC Gamer Supreme series delivers unparalleled gaming performance with cutting-edge processing power and the latest graphics cards. Designed to handle even the most demanding games, this gaming computer ensures a seamless and immersive experience for every gamer.

1051160570.description: Creed Aventus for Her Eau de Parfum 2.5 fl. oz. is a sophisticated fragrance crafted for women who exude confidence and elegance. This perfume captures a harmonious blend of vibrant and rich notes, making it both refreshing and opulent. It combines the freshness of citrus fruits with the allure of floral and woody undertones, resulting in a scent that is both captivating and versatile. Perfect for any occasion, it embodies a sense of empowerment and grace, making it an essential addition to any woman's fragrance collection.

1051160574.description: Reynolds Kitchens Unbleached Parchment Air Fryer Liners are designed to simplify your air fryer experience. Measuring 6.3 inches in diameter, these non-stick liners are perfect for round and square air fryers, ensuring your favorite meals lift out easily without sticking. Please note, these liners are not suitable for rectangular or toaster-style air fryers.

1051160575.description: Indulge in the rich, golden goodness of this versatile oil. Designed for use on hair, face, and body, it provides a comprehensive solution for your beauty needs. Its nourishing properties leave your skin and hair feeling soft, smooth, and revitalized. Boost your radiance and seal in moisture for a luminous, hydrated look.

1051160576.description: Indulge in the ultimate luxury with this exquisite multi-gemstone necklace. Crafted with the finest attention to detail, this necklace is a true masterpiece. The 14 karat yellow gold setting adds a touch of opulence, while the vibrant blue topaz, amethyst, peridot, citrine, and garnet gemstones are carefully selected to ensure a stunning and dazzling display of color.

1051160577.description:
Immersive Bass Experience
The Crusher 720 headphones are designed for bass enthusiasts, featuring patented adjustable Crusher® Bass technology. With an upgraded driver design, these headphones deliver deeper, more powerful bass that lets you feel every beat like never before.

1051160578.description: The Lancôme La Vie Est Belle 2-piece set offers a luxurious fragrance experience with both an Eau de Parfum spray and a matching body lotion, each in a convenient 1.7 fl oz size. The scent is a modern blend of sweet and floral notes, radiating elegance and joy. Layering the body lotion with the perfume enhances the lasting power and richness of the fragrance. This set makes a thoughtful gift or a perfect treat for anyone who loves a sophisticated and feminine scent.

1051160581.description: Upgrade your skincare routine with our Raw Silk Skincare Washcloths—an all-natural, reusable solution for gentle exfoliation & deep cleansing. These luxurious cloths are made from 100% raw silk, designed to deliver a spa-like experience in the comfort of your home. The finely textured silk works to loosen dead skin cells, effectively remove makeup, & leave your complexion smooth, soft, & glowing with every use.

1051160583.description: The Luminox Navy SEAL 45MM Stainless Steel Blue Dial Men's Watch is a bold, high-performance timepiece inspired by the elite units it's built to serve. Featuring a striking blue dial with contrasting white markers and Luminox Light Technology, this watch delivers constant illumination for up to 25 years—ensuring exceptional visibility in any environment, day or night. The robust 45mm stainless steel case offers enhanced durability with a refined edge, while the unidirectional rotating bezel adds functional versatility for timing activities. Powered by a precise Swiss quartz movement, it guarantees reliable accuracy, and with water resistance up to 200 meters, it's ready for serious water use and demanding conditions. Finished with a durable and comfortable strap, this watch combines tactical strength, premium materials, and standout style—making it the ultimate choice for those who demand performance without compromise.

1051160584.description: The Swedish Skincare Essentials LUNA mini 3 Set is a premium skincare package that includes a mini dual-sided brush suitable for all skin types, a balm, and a foam cleanser. This compact set is perfect for those who love to travel light, fitting easily into even the smallest cosmetic bags. The LUNA™ mini 3 brush combines ultra-hygienic, super-soft silicone and T-Sonic™ pulsations to remove 99.5% of impurities in just 1 minute, preparing your skin for enhanced absorption of skincare actives.

1051160585.description: Glad Press'n Seal Plastic Food Wrap (140 sq. ft./roll, 2 rolls) uses Griptex technology to protect food with a leak-proof and airtight seal. Great for storing and protecting leftovers, this multipurpose 3-in-1 wrap seals tightly onto a variety of surfaces, such as paper, plastic, metal, wood, glass, or other dry surfaces. The Griptex® technology activates when pressure is applied and seals to itself, allowing you to create custom-shaped food storage bags to freeze food or to make individual portions. With a quick press of a finger, Glad Press'n Seal Food Wrap keeps food fresh with a leak-proof, airtight seal. It even has a 10x tighter seal vs. foil alone* and is durable enough for you to stack on top.

1051160587.description:
Capture Memories Instantly
Fujifilm Instax Mini Instant Film lets you take pictures and get rapid results wherever you go. Designed to work seamlessly with Instax Mini cameras and printers (sold separately), this pack includes 60 exposures, allowing you to create physical prints of your favorite moments in an instant.

1051160588.description: Member's Mark Fenton 75" Console is a fully assembled storage console that pairs a spacious top for large TVs with flexible drawer-and-cabinet organization for living rooms and beyond.

1051160589.description: Break up with basic hair ties and experience the drama-free, damage-free hold of our Oversized 100% Silk Scrunchies. These luxe accessories are designed to glide through your hair with zero snagging and all the staying power. The voluminous silhouette adds a bold, fashion-forward edge to your look—perfect for effortless buns, thick ponytails, or wrist candy. Because your hair deserves to stand out in style.

1051160590.description: This 3 stone oval lab created diamond ring is a striking expression of timeless elegance and modern fine jewelry luxury. Crafted in 14K gold, this trilogy ring showcases a breathtaking 2.00 carat oval-cut lab created diamond center stone, flanked by two matching side diamonds for a total of 3.00 CT. T.W. Each lab created diamond is F color, VS2 clarity, and IGI certified, ensuring exceptional brilliance, verified quality, and outstanding value. Lab grown diamonds offer the same physical, chemical, and optical properties as mined diamonds, delivering remarkable sparkle and beauty. Available in 14K white gold or 14K yellow gold, this three stone diamond ring offers refined sophistication and impressive presence.

1051160591.description: The Member's Mark Harrison Leather Sectional brings a clean, classic-modern look together with scratch-resistant top-grain leather seating surfaces and supportive cushioning for everyday lounging and entertaining.

1051160593.description: The BEAR Facial Toning Device & SUPERCHARGED Serum 2.0 Bundle is a breakthrough in at-home skincare technology. This FDA-cleared microcurrent device, equipped with an Anti-Shock System™, combines the power of rejuvenating microcurrent technology and T-Sonic™ massage. This combination effectively trains and tones the muscles in your face and neck, providing professional-level power and results. Experience lasting youthful looks without stepping out of your home.

1051160594.description:
Discreet and Screenless Design
Experience the simplicity of the CIRQA™ Smart Band, a sleek and screenless health and fitness tracker designed to keep you focused without distractions. This innovative device offers 24/7 health monitoring without the need for a subscription, making it a hassle-free addition to your daily routine.

1051160595.description: Member's Mark Half Size Aluminum Steam Table Pans are great to have on hand for serving large groups, baking, or prepping food in something sturdy and disposable. Whether you're setting up a buffet for a party, cookout, or team event, these heavy-grade aluminum pans help you prep, serve, and clean up fast.

1051160596.description: By the Fireplace combines the comforting fragrance of vanilla with key notes of clove oil, chestnut, and cashmeran.Sam's Club is committed to offering quality products and services at an exceptional value. To serve this goal, these products were not purchased directly from the manufacturer or its authorized distributor but from a third-party dealer with strict controls to verify authenticity and quality. Some manufacturers limit or exclude their warranties on these products. However, these items remain fully covered by Sam's Club's 100% Merchandise Satisfaction Guarantee. If you are not satisfied with your purchase for any reason, return your item and we'll replace it or provide a refund.

1051160597.description: Elevate your everyday style with our 14K Yellow Gold 4.5MM Diamond Cut Paperclip Bracelet – 7"". Expertly crafted from genuine 14K yellow gold, this contemporary bracelet features bold 4.5MM paperclip links enhanced with a radiant diamond-cut finish that catches and reflects light from every angle for exceptional sparkle. The modern link design offers the perfect balance of sophistication and versatility, making it an effortless accessory for everyday wear as well as special occasions. Its timeless silhouette complements any wardrobe, adding a refined touch of luxury to every look.

1051160598.description: Furnish and organize your home with the Seville Classics Foldable Storage Bench Ottoman in Modern Gray. Remove the tufted cushion top to reveal a generous storage space area for organizing comforters, pillows, blankets, linens, toys, remotes and more! You can even purchase two ottoman benches and place them together to form a "coffee-table" center. This versatile ottoman can be used as a plush footrest in the living room or a bedside storage option for your comforters, extra pillows and blankets. It's also ideal as a bench in communal spaces such as dorm halls, or commercial environments like office waiting areas and lounges. The lightweight folding design means the bench sets up in seconds and takes up little space in storage.

1051160600.description: The CurrentBody Skin Laser Hair Removal Device is designed to deliver permanent, full-body hair removal in just 12 weeks. Utilizing advanced laser hair removal technology, this device targets hair follicles with a concentrated laser beam to effectively stop hair growth. Experience fast, precise, and lasting results with this innovative solution.

1051160601.description: Perfect for ski cabins and casual homes, this sleeper sofa lends charming lodge-inspired style. The upholstery is a mix of solid microfiber that looks like leather and printed-cotton tapestry featuring an outdoorsy motif. The solid-wood frame is durable and strong, while the cushions are soft and comfortable. The sleeper sofa opens easily with its Leggett & Platt mechanism and has a Queen-size mattress with inner-spring support.
